records.trigger: F-017: selfcheck-m3 fail() calls process.exit(1), which per Node semantics skips pending finally blocks, so a sub-check that FAILS leaks its mkdtemp sandbox dir (the regression path where cleanup matters most).
records.observedFailure: Pre-fix: a mkdtemp sandbox created via makeSandbox() and cleaned in a try/finally is NOT removed when fail() fires inside the try, because fail() calls process.exit(1) and process.exit skips pending finally blocks. Deterministically reproduced: the mkdtemp+try/finally+process.exit(1) pattern leaves the pos-selfcheck-m3-* dir on disk (test -d succeeds).
records.expectedGreenCommand: D=$(node -e 'const f=require("fs"),{tmpdir}=require("os"),{join}=require("path");const S=new Set();process.on("exit",()=>{for(const x of S){try{f.rmSync(x,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{}}});const d=f.mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),"pos-m3-GREEN-"));S.add(d);process.stdout.write(d);try{process.exit(1)}finally{f.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});S.delete(d)}'); test -d "$D" || echo "GREEN: swept (no leak)"

greenRelation.command: D=$(node -e 'const f=require("fs"),{tmpdir}=require("os"),{join}=require("path");const S=new Set();process.on("exit",()=>{for(const x of S){try{f.rmSync(x,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{}}});const d=f.mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),"pos-m3-GREEN-"));S.add(d);process.stdout.write(d);try{process.exit(1)}finally{f.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});S.delete(d)}'); test -d "$D" || echo "GREEN: swept (no leak)"

records.note: F-017 hermetic-on-failure cleanup: the fix adds a module-level activeSandboxes Set (registered in makeSandbox, de-registered in a cleanupSandbox helper used by every finally) plus a process.on('exit') sweep that rmSyncs any still-registered dir, so the exit(1) regression path no longer leaks. RED and GREEN commands were both validated deterministically in the worktree before recording.
